surfaces.name: lmdesk entry point and global parsing (prog=lmdesk; exit codes 0/1/2/3/4/5/6; SIGINT/SIGTERM become Interrupted; with --json a usage error prints {"error":{"code":"usage"}} to stdout; when CLI and desk versions differ, a warning goes to stderr)
Options shared by every leaf subcommand: --json, --timeout (default 1800s)
lmdesk status
lmdesk models (text output is tab-separated; --json wraps it as {models:[...]})
lmdesk ask <question> [--model] [--system] [--file ... repeatable] [--max-tokens]; also reads stdin when it is not a TTY
Decision logic: wait / swap / submit / fail, plus RETRY_CODES
Desk discovery: LMD_SHELL_PORT (default 8766); when the connection is refused, starts the enclosing .app hidden with open -gj (waits up to 60s); classifies sandbox errors (EPERM/EACCES → exit 6)
HTTP client (GET/POST/PATCH; maps errors to refused / sandbox / other and HttpError)
Waiter: backoff 2→5s, a progress line on stderr every 15s, overall deadline
Version source: bundle.json bundle_version → packaging/VERSION → unknown; environment override LMDESK_FAKE_VERSION
lmdesk image sessions
lmdesk image new <name>
lmdesk image show <session>
lmdesk image gen <session> <prompt> [--seed --out --force --no-wait --size(1024x1024) --steps(40) --from --strength(0.6)]
lmdesk image wait <session> <attempt> [--out]
lmdesk image rename <session> <name>
lmdesk video sessions/new/show/wait/rename
lmdesk video gen <session> <prompt> [--seed --out --force --no-wait --size(768x448) --frames(49|73|124|192|243|362, default 124) --steps(16) --continue | --first-frame <file|image:session:attempt>]
lmdesk video join <session> <parts...> [--out --no-wait] (at least 2 parts)
lmdesk music sessions/new/show/wait/rename
lmdesk music gen <session> <prompt> [--seed --out --force --no-wait --lyrics | --lyrics-file (exactly one required) --duration(60) --continue]
lmdesk music join <session> <parts...> [--out --no-wait]

Interrupt and resume during generation: SIGINT cancels the job (POST /api/media/cancel {job_id}); SIGTERM, timeout, or desk exit print a resume hint for lmdesk <kind> wait; signals are blocked while the submit request is in flight
Copying output with --out (directory or file; prints '已覆盖' when overwriting)
GET /api/agent/precheck?op=chat|image|video|music (plus model / width,height,steps / frames / duration)
GET /api/agent-skill (targets[] + cli link status)
POST /api/agent-skill {targets:[claude|codex|pi|dsh]} (install selected, uninstall the rest; ~/.local/bin/lmdesk is linked when at least one target is installed)
POST /api/agent-skill/check (runs <cli> status --json --timeout 10)
Agent skill link states: installed / stale / occupied / absent / error; recognizing our own scripts/lmdesk requires a desk/agent_cli directory beside it
Agent targets: claude(~/.claude/skills), codex(~/.agents/skills, shared_note), pi(~/.pi/agent/skills), dsh(~/.dsh/skills); detected by command on PATH or by path
Bundled SKILL.md (local-model-desk): call conventions, chat, image, video, music, exit codes, examples
user_home() as the single place HOME is read
GET /api/state adds the fields version and agent_skill_stale
POST /api/llm/load accepts origin (agent|ui, default ui)
GET /api/llm/status adds fields active_chats, ui_chat_recent (UI chat within 300s), loaded_by (agent|ui|null)
Chat counting: /api/llm/chat and /api/llm/chat/stream increment and decrement active_chats; requests whose origin is not agent update last_ui_chat
LlmService.precheck_load(key) (dry run of the arbiter, no acquire)
POST /api/media/inputs/discard {id} (deletes .inputs/<32hex>.<ext>; malformed or unknown ids are a no-op)
POST /api/media/cancel accepts optional job_id (must be an int, else 400 invalid_params; returns 409 job_not_running if the id does not match the running job)
MediaService.precheck_image / precheck_media(video|music|image)
Settings page section '本机 agent' (local agents): checkbox per target, Apply (disabled until something changes), Check, cli line, try-it phrase with Copy, error line
Chat page notice when an agent switches the model (dismissible)
Frontend API functions agentSkillStatus / agentSkillApply / agentSkillCheck
Styles .agent-skill-* / .agent-switch-notice
Menu bar: agentSkillStale parsing, a menu item 'agent 链接指向旧位置，打开设置更新' (agent links point at an old location, open Settings to update; clicking opens Settings), and a dot on the status icon
Swift harness subcommand agent-skill-note
Packaging: generates Contents/Resources/bin/lmdesk (embedded python3.13 -s -m desk.agent_cli, follows symlinks)
Development entry scripts/lmdesk (LMDESK_PYTHON overrides the interpreter)

Uninstall removes agent links (~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/skills, ~/.agents/skills, ~/.pi/agent/skills, ~/.dsh/skills /local-model-desk, ~/.local/bin/lmdesk); only symlinks pointing at our targets; honors --dry-run
